create_infsampler: create an InfSampler to infinitely sample elements from a dataset with optional shuffling
create_distributed_infsampler: create a DistributedInfSampler to partition infinite sampling across distributed training replicas and ranks
reset_permutation_infsampler: reset the permutation of an InfSampler to reshuffle or resequence the data source
use_infsampler_next: use the next method of InfSampler to get the next sample index from the dataset
review_distributed_infsampler: review the DistributedInfSampler class to understand how it partitions samples across GPU replicas
